summary: Engineering preview: native Instrument Teal HOME/banks and Groove/Loop/Mix/Click now lead into EDIT for a protected sixteen-slot semantic draft. Numbered chord/timing/voicing/bass/phrase controls, explicit remove confirmation and one-step undo feed the same accompaniment clock; quarter slots, gates/ties and bar-bound groove edits preserve phase. Active and pending plans, real cursor and planned focus stay distinct. Safe stopped-only checkpoints report RAM Pending, verified Checkpoint or Recovered, with checked backup object 75. Native editor count-in/capture stays visible with real REC status and read-only draft controls. Factory originals, live Harmony/HOLD and the current manual-take/latest-three policy remain protected. Chord Lab now adds native Notes/Intervals/Compare/Next tabs, explicitly labelled Now/Last/planned slots, factual outside-scale tones, one-bar comparison/candidate auditions, deterministic local-catalogue suggestions with theory fallback, and explicit undoable slot replacement. Audition preserves the shared clock/drums and resumes the current gated chord; live HOLD and recording/replay block it. Numbered Songs, chord-library, arranged recording, remaining page/motion migration and physical verification are pending.

limits: Physical TFT readability, latency and USB/hardware stress remain unverified.
Recording/replay must finish before audition or insertion.
Compare uses a captured target and fixed preceding voicing; identical Root/Smooth results are disabled.
Audition is monophonic in harmonic ownership: chord preview mutes scheduled chord/bass while groove and cursor continue.
Now/Last/history follow foreground semantic chord snapshots, not individual arpeggiated notes.
